phase_note: Amended 2026-07-25 after cross-spec review; approvals retained. (1) BLOCKING, fixed: the heart-rate channel reported intensity = impulse_ratio, which is the SQUARE of the power and pace channels' intensity and coincides with them only at 1.0 — the single point the old scale-invariance test exercised. HR intensity is now sqrt(impulse_ratio); the HR load value is unchanged by construction and asserted so. New criteria 1.11 (one intensity semantic: load == hours x intensity^2 x 100, all channels), 5.11 (HR intensity is the square root; load unaffected; divergence recorded), 8.7 (cross-channel intensity agreement verified at MORE THAN ONE point, including sub-threshold anchors ~120 and ~140 bpm where the two definitions differ by ~0.24 and ~0.19). New task 5.3 owns tests/load/channels/test_intensity_semantic.py; the old 5.3 became 5.4. The divergence from intervals.icu — which publishes an HRSS load definition but no heart-rate intensity definition — is recorded with its reason in DIVERGENCES. (2) VerificationStatus now defines all three members in task 1.1, including FITDOCS_MEASURED, so activity-qa-flags only uses it and never widens this spec's enum or edits its test module; MINETTI_2002 and BANISTER_TRIMP remain SECONDARY_ATTESTATION and no citation here carries the new status; criterion 8.2 restated for three statuses. (3) The unimplementable 'DIVERGENCES keys are unique' invariant is restated over fields that exist — Citation.key unique, Divergence.behavior unique — as new criterion 8.8; no key field was added to Divergence. Also fixed an internal contradiction: src/fitdocs/load/settings.py is owned by training-load with the pinned signature load_load_settings(document: Mapping[str, object], settings_file: Path) -> LoadSettings, LoadSettingsError(SettingsError), DEFAULT_LOAD_SETTINGS and every field defaulted — not athlete-benchmarks. Criteria: 85 (was 81). Leaf tasks: 15 (was 14). Amended again 2026-07-27 (queue 2026-07-26-citation-vocabulary-diverges-across-layers, maintainer decision: load-channels adopts fit-ingest Req 15.4's bar rather than keeping a weaker one): new criteria 8.9 (a new SECONDARY_ATTESTATION is forbidden where a defining published work exists) and 8.10 (an exception under 8.9 records its search). COGGAN_TSS, MINETTI_2002 and INTERVALS_ICU_PACE_LOAD re-sourced from SECONDARY_ATTESTATION to PRIMARY_TEXT after locating and reading their actual primary texts (see each Citation's note in src/fitdocs/load/channels/sources.py). BANISTER_TRIMP is the sole remaining SECONDARY_ATTESTATION, now named in the new BLOCKED_CITATIONS frozenset as a tracked exception rather than a silent acceptance — Banister (1991, a controlled-digital-lending book chapter) and Morton, Fitz-Clarke & Banister (1990, a paywalled journal article with no free mirror found) were both searched for and neither obtained. No task added or renumbered; task 1.1's existing ProvenanceRecord task absorbs 8.9/8.10 as it already owns VerificationStatus and the Citation records. Criteria: 87 (was 85). Leaf tasks: 15 (unchanged). Amended again 2026-07-27 (review remediation, same queue item, now reopened rather than closed pending merge): criterion 7.9's wording corrected in place (no new criterion, count unchanged at 87) — it previously said the Minetti walking form 'was not obtained', which the same session's re-sourcing of MINETTI_2002 to PRIMARY_TEXT falsified (Fig. 1's caption, read in full, gives both the running and the walking regressions together). 7.9 now records the true reason the walking form is unimplemented: a scope choice, not a sourcing gap. design.md's GradeAdjustment responsibilities bullet (previously reworded to match reality while 7.9 stood unamended and now-false) is reconciled with it. Also softened sources.py's and design.md's 'holds itself to the same bar as fit-ingest Req 15.4' framing to 'a named-exception variant of that bar' — 15.4 has no exception set; 8.10 gives BANISTER_TRIMP one via BLOCKED_CITATIONS — and flagged for the maintainer whether that variant is the intended reading of 'load-channels adopts fit-ingest's bar' or a weakening. Corrected BANISTER_TRIMP.work's title/year mismatch (the 1982 first edition's title was cited under the 1991 second edition's year) and its note's false 'no computed value depends on resolving this citation' claim (the heart-rate channel does consume these coefficients, per Req 8.6, and fit-ingest's own Amendment 1 rationale states the sex-neutral collapse changes some athletes' reported number). Added two tests: an AST-based registry-completeness check over sources.py's own module-level Citation(...) definitions (a citation defined but never appended to CITATIONS was previously invisible to every existing test), and a check that a BLOCKED_CITATIONS note actually names both attempted sources and why each failed (a placeholder non-empty note previously passed). Criteria: 87 (unchanged, wording-only revision to 7.9). Leaf tasks: 15 (unchanged). Amended again 2026-07-29 (queue 2026-07-27-banister-morton-primary-texts-obtained): BANISTER_TRIMP, the sole remaining SECONDARY_ATTESTATION citation named above, is re-sourced to PRIMARY_TEXT. The maintainer supplied both previously-unobtainable texts 2026-07-27 -- Banister (1991) as page scans of the full chapter 9 (pp. 403-424) and Morton, Fitz-Clarke & Banister (1990) as the publisher PDF -- and both were read in full and extracted to docs/reference/banister-trimp-primary-sources.md, which settles the citation's content (B91 p. 408 and M90 Eq. 2 p. 1172 agree exactly on the exponents 1.92/1.67 and disagree on whether a leading coefficient exists; the maintainer ruled 2026-07-27 to keep B91's 0.64, so no value in metrics/stress.py moves and no migration-by-regen is owed). BANISTER_TRIMP.locator is no longer None and BANISTER_TRIMP.verification is PRIMARY_TEXT. BLOCKED_CITATIONS is now the empty frozenset, kept in place (not deleted) as the still-live Req 8.9/8.10 exception mechanism. Criteria 8.9 and 8.10's wording is corrected in place to describe the mechanism rather than name BANISTER_TRIMP as its current occupant (no criterion added, renumbered or withdrawn; count unchanged at 87). Six whole-note equality backstops were added to tests/load/channels/test_sources.py (queue 2026-07-28-load-channel-citation-notes-unpinned), one per citation record, closing the gap where every note's factual content was previously guarded only by non-emptiness. No task added or renumbered; task 1.1's existing ProvenanceRecord task absorbs this re-sourcing as it already owns the Citation records. Leaf tasks: 15 (unchanged).
